name: gimnasio
description: Proyecto universitario de gestion de gimnasio: API (NestJS), panel de administracion (Next.js) y app publica de estudiantes (Astro).

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@gimnasio/shared && (npm run dev --workspace=api & npm run dev --workspace=admin & npm run dev --workspace=web & wait)
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@gimnasio/shared && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=admin && npm run build --workspace=web
